question: Who among the following was popularly known as ‘Lokhitwadi’?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Gopal Hari Deshmukh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gopal Hari Deshmukh** was a **Maharashtra-born **Indian **activist, thinker, social reformer, and writer. **
 
• **Shidhaye** was his birth name.
 
• In Maharashtra,** Deshmukh **is regarded as a key player in the **Social Reform Movement.**
 
• Deshmukh began contributing pieces to the **weekly Prabhakar** under the pen name **Lokhitawadi **at the age of 25 with a focus on** social transformation in Maharashtra.**
 
• He wrote** 108 social reform-related papers **in the first two years.
 
• In Marathi literature, that collection of essays has come to be known as **Lokhitawadinchi Shatapatre.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jyotiba Phule:**

 
 
• He was also known as** Mahatma Jyotiba Phule.**
 
• He was a **Maharashtrian writer, anti-caste social reformer, and social activist.**
 
 
 
• **Gopal Krishna Gokhale**:
 
 
• He was a** social reformer and "moderate" political figure** in India during the **struggle for independence.**
 
• He was a contributor to the **Poona Association or Poona Sarvajanik Sabha.**
 
 
 
• **Swami Vivekananda:**
 
 
• Swami Vivekananda was an** Indian Hindu monk** who was also a** philosopher, writer, and religious instructor.** 
 
• His birthday is observed in India as **National Youth Day** because he is revered as a** patriotic saint.**
